tools.name: murfai_list_voices
tools.description: List the stock voices for one model: falcon-2.1 (streaming voices) or gen2 (synthesis voices). Returns voiceId, displayName, locale, gender and available styles. Use a voiceId from here in murfai_generate_speech. Murf API: GET /v1/speech/voices.

tools.name: murfai_list_cloned_voices
tools.description: List the cloned voices in this workspace: voiceId (prefix cln_), displayName, tag and createdAt. Murf API: GET /v1/speech/voices/cloned.

tools.name: murfai_get_voice_clone_status
tools.description: Check a voice-cloning job by its requestId: status is QUEUED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED or FAILED. On COMPLETED it returns the voiceId; on FAILED it returns errorMessage. Murf API: GET /v1/speech/voice-clone-creation-status/{requestId}.

tools.name: murfai_generate_speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech with the GEN2 model and return a URL to the audio file, its length, the characters used and the characters left. WRITE action: each call spends Murf credits. Murf API: POST /v1/speech/generate.

tools.name: murfai_translate_text
tools.description: Translate a list of texts into one target language and return the translations in the same order. Spends Murf credits. Murf API: POST /v1/text/translate.

tools.name: murfai_delete_cloned_voice
tools.description: Delete one cloned voice by its voiceId (prefix cln_). This cannot be undone: the voice can no longer generate speech. Murf API: DELETE /v1/speech/voices/cloned/{voiceId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: murfai_translate_text · Private data: murfai_generate_speech · Public sink: murfai_generate_speech, murfai_translate_text · Destructive: murfai_delete_cloned_voice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: murfai_translate_text · Private data: murfai_generate_speech · Public sink: murfai_generate_speech, murfai_translate_text · Destructive: murfai_delete_cloned_voice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
